name.description: Immutable. The name of the custom constraint. This is unique within the organization.
name.security_impact: Identifies the custom constraint for enforcement and auditing.
name.rationale: Unique names prevent overlap or accidental override of constraints.

condition.description: A CEL condition that refers to a supported service resource, for example `resource.management.autoUpgrade == false`. For details about CEL usage, see [Common Expression Language](https://cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/organization-policy/creating-managing-custom-constraints#common_expression_language).
condition.security_impact: Defines the enforcement logic to prevent insecure configurations.
condition.rationale: Improper conditions may weaken or break enforcement.

action_type.description: The action to take if the condition is met. Possible values are: `ALLOW`, `DENY`.
action_type.security_impact: Determines how violations are handled (deny insecure behavior).
action_type.rationale: Correctly setting this ensures insecure actions are blocked instead of allowed.

method_types.description: A list of RESTful methods for which to enforce the constraint. Can be `CREATE`, `UPDATE`, or both. Not all Google Cloud services support both methods. To see supported methods for each service, find the service in [Supported services](https://cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/organization-policy/custom-constraint-supported-services).
method_types.security_impact: Ensures enforcement during resource creation and modification.
method_types.rationale: Without restricting both methods, insecure updates may bypass enforcement.

resource_types.description: Immutable. The fully qualified name of the Google Cloud REST resource containing the object and field you want to restrict. For example, `container.googleapis.com/NodePool`.
resource_types.security_impact: Defines which resources are affected by the policy.
resource_types.rationale: Misconfigured resource types may lead to policies not being applied at all.

parent.description: The parent of the resource, an organization. Format should be `organizations/{organization_id}`.
parent.security_impact: Ensures enforcement applies across the correct org.
parent.rationale: Incorrect parent scope could leave projects without enforcement.

display_name.description: A human-friendly name for the constraint.
display_name.rationale: Descriptive display names improve clarity during reviews.

description.description: A human-friendly description of the constraint to display as an error message when the policy is violated.
description.security_impact: Provides clarity for admins when violations occur.
description.rationale: Clear error messages make violations easier to resolve securely.

security_policies.title: Restrict External Buckets
security_policies.rationale: Prevents buckets outside the org from being attached to Dataplex or BigQuery.

security_policies.title: Restrict Service Account Impersonation
security_policies.rationale: Prevents users from impersonating high-privilege service accounts.

security_policies.title: Restrict Cross-Project Networking
security_policies.rationale: Prevents attaching VPCs across projects unless explicitly whitelisted.

security_policies.title: Restrict VM Images
security_policies.rationale: Ensures only approved VM images can be deployed (prevents shadow IT).
